about: The burg on the valley floor on a clear late-summer morning (the world's own first day, no date: on 09-22 at 06:06 the valley stood under cloud 0.93 and read grey and autumnal, castle fall round 20), the forest round the meadow and the range's wall behind; a dragon comes in over the trees, strafes its south wall with fire, hovers off the south-east tower to breathe into its timber storey, and its towers and keep come down, the keep after the dragon breathes down into it, in twenty-five seconds
